items.title: Show HN: Privacy Layer for Frontier Models
items.contentSnippet:
Kinda crazy how many people submit their sensitive information to frontier models. Tax documents, health data, financial transactions etc.
Built this as a proof of concept. Venice AI is on a similar wavelength where they limit identity connected to prompts, but not information in the prompts.
Sometimes it's tough to actually filter all sensitive information and keep the same quality in responses. I can share the github if anyone is interested.

items.title: Show HN: Omasharp: Build Omarchy apps with C# and .NET
items.contentSnippet:
To get started, tell your agents to build an app with https://github.com/luisrudge/omasharp and they'll do the rest!
Apps use QmL, so they look and feel like Omarchy apps (usually built with C++ + QmL). They are also AOT-compiled, so you don't pay the startup price.
I started my career as a .NET developer, so this was a fun project to hack on!

items.contentSnippet:
